text: On the medium and high settings, what stands on the land is now made of small cubes too. Boulders are rounded rocks in several shapes, with moss on green ground. Shrubs are leafy clumps, some with berries or flowers. Cacti grow arms and ribs, and crystals have points and facets. Flames taper and flicker. A burnt forest leaves scattered charred stumps with a few glowing embers, not a grid of brown blocks. Clouds are puffy. Big box-built things show their small cubes, with lighter top edges.
